  1. sequences - closesness, how much overlap there is and (evalue) the probabilty that this match could happen by chance

There is 100% overlap with three differnt species, Chilatherina alleni, Aulotrachichthy novaezelandicus, and Protomyctophum arctrium.Depending on how related these species are this overlap could be expected but since the read is so short that could also explain why there is a lot of overlap.

  1. could be very short exact match found in lots of taxa
